'''Sehvorah''' was a [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] member of the [[Council of Three]], the governing body for the criminal alliance called [[Mandroxan]]. Other members of the Council were [[Artur Manliss]] (the de facto leader) and [[Parmella Trillidor]].
